scientific_integrity: All enumeration is exhaustive for a fixed 17-vertex complex. The paper distinguishes finite field certificates from the previously published integral homotopy calculation.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary open Paley-17 neighborhood complex and degree-two mod-three homology. The independent finite proof reconstructs the graph and all minimal carriers but does not calculate a complete integral Smith form or prove a generalization. Bibliographic uniqueness is not established.
title: Minimum four-vertex torsion carriers in the Paley-seventeen neighborhood complex
